title: Explicit extractors for bounded-degree polynomial sources over constant-order fields of small characteristic
author: Eli Ben-Sasson and Ariel Gabizon
work: Extractors for Polynomial Sources over Fields of Constant Order and Small Characteristic
source_version: Theory of Computing volume 9 article 21 (2013), official complete journal PDF acquired 2026-09-30; canonical DOI 10.4086/toc.2013.v009a021 verified against official landing and printed PDF header
difficulty_reason: After named finite-field character-sum and product-dimension background, the target still has to construct a single-sample Frobenius product with distinct monomial exponents and full coefficient span, project it to a nonconstant low-degree map, and force the nondegeneracy needed for the Weil bound. Complete new power/nondegeneracy and multivariate line-restriction arguments occur at1199–1290, followed by source-authored prime-padding and explicit degree/error bounds at1295–1331. These single-source algebraic extractor obligations are one H2 construction beyond a direct application of a quoted character-sum inequality.

source_check.note: Exact original Main--Extractor Theorem1.5 only, with all original characteristic/order, n>=25,4<=k<=n, individual/total degree, output-m and alpha=3D(pd)^{3n/k} hypotheses/error. Complete polynomial-source/extractor model, coefficient-field view, new Frobenius-product construction/full-span proof/projection, source-supplied product-dimension and Frobenius support, full nondegeneracy power lemma credited to Swastik Kopparty, multivariate-to-line character-sum argument, prime-dimension padding and parameterized extractor closing are retained. Named Weil-Carlitz-Uchiyama, Rao XOR, Schwartz-Zippel, Nagura prime-gap and finite-field representation facts are prerequisites; all new local construction/nondegeneracy/parameter material is supplied. Disperser, quadratic/F4 and other parameterized specializations are uncounted context/core. Private author-note/remove macros are excluded, with no active calls in selected body; no upstream class/script or style execution. All-page source/output QA completed and exact final actual logs checked. Source-material candidate only; no admission/remote-delivery credit. Root admitted this exact original authored material as one H2 unit; source quirks retained unchanged.

root_decision.source_quirks_note: The original Weil and nondegeneracy paragraphs literally use h^p+h+c (including for general characteristic); every such source formula is retained without sign substitution. The informal overview at807 refers to analysis in an appendix, while the acquired journal source supplies the full extractor analysis in Section6 at1295–1331, which is included. The original overview polynomial indices and full-span projection wording are also preserved; no mathematical-refereeing or generated repair is supplied.
